baseline_models.focus_anchor: يُوفُونَ بِٱلنَّذْرِ with وَفَى and نذر
baseline_models.mechanism: A voluntarily assumed obligation is carried without shortfall while anticipation of a severe event-day keeps present conduct answerable to a future horizon.

activation_trace.role: Complete fullness without shortfall supplies the act of carrying an obligation all the way through.
Self-binding to what was otherwise non-obligatory supplies the obligation that completion answers.
Fearful anticipation of harm supplies the future-oriented pressure that sustains fulfillment.
The event-day or severe occasion makes the feared horizon an occurrence of concentrated consequence.

changed_reading.before: They fulfill vows and fear a bad day.
changed_reading.after: They complete a chosen self-obligation because present action is lived under the pressure of a consequential future occasion.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: النذر can activate warning as well as vow, while يُوفُونَ supplies completion
baseline_models.mechanism: The construction can carry a secondary reading in which a warning becomes full or effective when its hearers enact the caution it was meant to awaken.

activation_trace.role: A warning that awakens fear and caution supplies a live non-vow image for النذر.
Completion without shortfall lets the warning be realized fully in conduct rather than merely heard.
Anticipatory fear is the behavioral uptake that makes the warning operative.

changed_reading.before: The noun denotes only a private vow.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they bring the warning to completion by letting it produce the caution and conduct it announces.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: شَرُّهُ مُسْتَطِيرًا with شرر and طير branch images
baseline_models.mechanism: The evil of the day is not a bounded object but a propagation event: it flashes, scatters, and reaches outward as loose airborne material.

activation_trace.role: Flying sparks supply a material image of harm reproducing through dispersed points.
The non-dominant lightning branch supplies repeated flashing across a field as a second propagation image.
Spreading as if flying loose turns مُسْتَطِيرًا into the spatial mechanism of nonlocal harm.

changed_reading.before: The day is simply very evil.
changed_reading.after: Its evil behaves like a distributed hazard whose defining danger is that it will not stay contained.

baseline_models.mechanism: Fulfillment can be heard as repeated arrival at an appointed obligation, nested inside anticipation of the ultimate event at which the day and its evil become present.

activation_trace.role: Arrival for an appointed meeting recasts fulfillment as showing up at the obligation's due point.
The event-day supplies the larger appointment toward which each smaller fulfillment is oriented.
Occurrence or temporal presence supplies the transition from anticipated appointment to realized event.

changed_reading.before: Fulfillment is only compliance with a promise.
changed_reading.after: Fulfillment is also punctual arrival: they keep meeting chosen due points while expecting the event-day to arrive in full.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The split mapping of شَرّ activates exchange and equivalence beside وفاء and نذر
baseline_models.mechanism: A legal-economic shadow reading treats the feared day as a settlement field where incurred liabilities are matched and discharged in full.

activation_trace.role: Full measure, right, account, or recompense supplies complete settlement rather than partial payment.
Obligatory compensation for a wound supplies a liability incurred by harm.
The non-dominant exchange branch supplies a transaction-like frame for consequence.
Equivalence and matching supply the idea that an act may meet its counterpart.

changed_reading.before: The verse contrasts good conduct with generic evil.
changed_reading.after: At the edge of the branch inventory, it contrasts obligations discharged now with liabilities liable to exact settlement on the feared day.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus acts become observable responses within a test and a shown path: chosen obligation and fear disclose which way a furnished human agent actually travels.

activation_trace.role: Complete performance supplies the focus behavior whose quality can be disclosed.
Voluntary self-binding supplies an exercise of agency inside the test.
Testing that makes a condition appear supplies the disclosure function assigned to the focus conduct.
Gentle indication toward the path supplies prior orientation rather than unguided fear.
A traversable extended road turns fulfillment into movement along a disclosed course.

structural_cues: 76:2-3 places testing and path-guidance before the focus characterization in 76:7.
The sequence moves from created capacities to a bifurcating response and then to concrete conduct.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies test, guidance, path, and the later conduct; I infer that 76:7 displays the test's result. A live alternative is that the focus merely lists virtues without defining how the test is passed.

changed_reading.before: Vow fulfillment is an isolated devotional trait.
changed_reading.after: It is a diagnostic enactment of guided agency, making an inwardly chosen course visible under test.

context_deltas.mechanism: The voluntary binding of نذر is set against linked chains and collars amid kindled fire, so present self-obligation appears as an alternative to future coercive binding inside spreading harm.

activation_trace.role: Chosen self-binding supplies the focus side of the voluntary versus imposed restraint contrast.
Loose spreading supplies the uncontained motion surrounding the coercive apparatus.
Connected rings and parts supply externally linked confinement.
A collar that binds a limb supplies bodily coercion opposite the self-imposed vow.
Kindled fire supplies the energetic hazard in which imposed binding occurs.

structural_cues: 76:4 names chains, collars, and blaze immediately before the drink and conduct sequence of 76:5-7.
The packet juxtaposes two kinds of binding: a vow assumed by the subject and restraints prepared for others.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies voluntary obligation and coercive restraints; I infer a contrast in modes of binding and an arrow from chosen restraint to escape from imposed restraint. The alternative is simple juxtaposition without causal or ethical symmetry.

changed_reading.before: A vow is merely another duty.
changed_reading.after: The vow is chosen binding that disciplines the self before harm arrives as external binding and ignition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The packet develops two opposed distribution systems: evil flies outward without containment, while a spring is deliberately opened and its drink circulates to recipients. Fulfillment participates in a controlled, life-giving counterflow.

activation_trace.role: Flying sparks supply hazardous distribution by multiplication and scatter.
Flying-loose spread supplies the focus pattern that the water circulation reverses.
A source of running water supplies the beneficial material being distributed.
Wide splitting and emission supply deliberate release rather than accidental leakage.
Circling around something supplies ordered delivery through a social space.
Quenching a drinker supplies the beneficial endpoint of the controlled flow.

structural_cues: The spring-opening statement in 76:6 immediately precedes the focus verse.
76:15-21 repeatedly circulates vessels and drink, extending the distribution image across the reward scene.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies harmful spread, an opened spring, circulation, and quenching; I infer that these are opposed flow regimes and that fulfillment aligns with the nourishing one. They may alternatively be independent threat and reward images.

changed_reading.before: The verse praises obligation while separately describing widespread evil.
changed_reading.after: Fulfillment belongs to a counter-distribution system: disciplined action releases and routes benefit against harm that propagates indiscriminately.

context_deltas.mechanism: The vow's fullness is measured outwardly by giving desired food to people marked by need, severed guardianship, and confinement. Self-binding becomes a transfer of provision toward those whose agency or support is constrained.

activation_trace.role: Full completion supplies the standard by which the following social action fills out the vow.
Chosen self-obligation supplies the inward constraint translated into outward provision.
Feeding another supplies the concrete act through which obligation reaches a recipient.
Love lodged in the heart supplies the retained value that makes giving costly rather than residual.
The abasement of need supplies one form of constrained social position receiving provision.
Severance of a child from a guardian supplies loss of protective support.
Binding and confinement supply the strongest case of externally restricted agency.

structural_cues: 76:8 continues the plural present-tense characterization begun in 76:7.
The recipient list moves across poverty, lost guardianship, and captivity rather than remaining within a single social category.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies grammatical continuation and three constrained recipients; I infer that feeding operationalizes what full vow-performance looks like. The alternative is that 76:7 and 76:8 list independent virtues.

changed_reading.before: Fulfilling a vow is private ritual exactness.
changed_reading.after: Its fullness is socially testable: chosen obligation becomes costly provision for people whose support or freedom is diminished.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exchange-shadow in شَرّ is corrected by an explicit refusal to seek return: action is directionally oriented beyond the recipients, while recompense and appreciation later arrive without being extracted from them.

activation_trace.role: Giving a right or account in full supplies performance that does not depend on partial bargaining.
The non-dominant buying-and-selling image supplies the transactional model that context revises.
Direction and orientation supply an axis for action other than return from the recipient.
Will and intention locate non-transactionality at the level of what the givers seek.
An act met by its recompense supplies the return that is granted later rather than demanded from recipients.
Recognition of benefit supplies appreciation that returns to the striving after human thanks was disclaimed.

structural_cues: 76:9 negates both desired recompense and thanks from the fed recipients.
76:12 and 76:22 later restore recompense and appreciated striving from a different source.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denied human return followed by granted recompense and appreciation; I infer an asymmetrical economy in which fulfillment is not purchased by its beneficiaries. The alternative is that the denial and later reward are unrelated motive and outcome statements.

changed_reading.before: Fulfillment can be imagined as balancing a ledger to secure an equivalent return.
changed_reading.after: It is unilateral toward the vulnerable: return is neither the price nor the motive, even though recompense later answers the act.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus fear is repeated, the day is intensified as severe and pervasively harmful, and then the same evil is actively warded off while a different encounter is delivered. Fear is accurate anticipation that reorganizes action before a reversal of what will be met.

activation_trace.role: Anticipation of harm supplies the focus disposition confirmed by repetition.
Arrival at an appointment supplies the focus-side expectation of eventually meeting an outcome.
Repeated fearful anticipation confirms that the earlier fear is deliberate and shared rather than incidental.
A severe event-day confirms the concentrated occasion anticipated in the focus.
A severe day whose evil is widespread explicitly sharpens the focus propagation model.
Repelling harm by protection supplies the reversal from anticipated exposure to shielding.
The repeated evil root identifies exactly what protection blocks.
What a person meets of good or evil supplies replacement of the feared encounter by radiance and joy.

structural_cues: 76:10 repeats both fear and day from 76:7 with harsher predicates.
76:11 repeats evil and immediately reverses exposure through protection and a newly delivered encounter.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repetition followed by protection and encounter; I infer that present fear and fulfillment mediate preparedness for the reversal. A live alternative is a reward sequence without a direct causal role for fear itself.

changed_reading.before: Fear is an inward emotion attached to an ominous day.
changed_reading.after: Fear is accurate anticipatory orientation: it shapes conduct before the day, after which exposure to its evil is reversed into a different encounter.

context_deltas.mechanism: Fulfillment acquires duration: an obligation reaches fullness through restrained endurance and sustained purposive work, which are then answered as a completed course rather than a punctual gesture.

activation_trace.role: Completion without deficiency supplies the endpoint of a process that must be maintained.
Self-obligation supplies the commitment that persists across time.
Recompense answering an act supplies recognition of the completed course.
Holding the self back from panic supplies the temporal endurance by which obligation remains intact.
Work, earning, and practical activity supply sustained effort rather than a single vow event.

structural_cues: 76:12 makes endurance the stated basis of recompense.
76:22 looks back on the whole effort as appreciated striving.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies completion, endurance, recompense, and retrospective striving; I infer that endurance is the temporal mechanism of fulfillment. The alternative is that patience is a separate rewarded trait.

changed_reading.before: A vow is fulfilled at the instant its promised act is performed.
changed_reading.after: Fulfillment is durational integrity: the self-bound course remains whole through restraint and sustained work.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later positive circulation and pearl-like scattering prevent a simplistic equation of spatial dispersion with evil. What makes the focus spread dangerous is its harmful content and uncontrolled reach, not distribution as such.

activation_trace.role: Flying-loose spread supplies the spatial pattern initially associated with evil.
Flying sparks supply destructive content carried by the spatial pattern.
Orderly circulation supplies a beneficial distributed movement.
Casting things in a scattered array supplies positive dispersion in the pearl simile.

structural_cues: 76:19 places circling attendants and scattered-pearl appearance within the positive reward scene.
The same whole-surah packet therefore assigns opposite valences to different forms of distributed motion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies negative spread and positive circulation/scatter; I infer that control, content, and endpoint determine valence. The alternative is that the later images are visually decorative and do not qualify مُسْتَطِيرًا.

changed_reading.before: Spreading itself is the evil property.
changed_reading.after: The evil is a particular kind of spread: harmful, uncontained, and exposure-producing, unlike ordered circulation or luminous scatter.

context_deltas.mechanism: Fear becomes an act of temporal weighting: the subject refuses to let love of what comes quickly hide a consequential day. The day is heavy even though its evil spreads with airborne lightness, joining gravity of consequence to speed of propagation.

activation_trace.role: Anticipatory fear supplies attention to a harm not yet present.
A severe occasion supplies the future object that must retain weight in present choice.
Airborne lightness and speed supply the paradoxical mobility of the heavy day's evil.
Love lodged in the heart supplies the present attachment competing with future regard.
Haste and bringing forward supply the bias toward immediate availability.
Leaving something supplies active neglect of the future day.
The side behind, ahead, or beyond supplies the future being put out of operative view.
The repeated severe occasion identifies the neglected day with the focus horizon.
Heaviness opposed to lightness supplies consequence-weight against the flight image in مُسْتَطِيرًا.

structural_cues: 76:27 contrasts love of the immediate with leaving a heavy day beyond consideration.
The repeated day root links this closing diagnosis back to the object of fear in 76:7.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies immediate attachment, neglect, a heavy day, and focus flight imagery; I infer a temporal decision model and a deliberate heavy/light contrast. The alternative is that heaviness and airborne spread are independent intensifiers.

changed_reading.before: They fear because the future is frightening.
changed_reading.after: They correctly weight the future against immediate attraction, recognizing a day whose consequences are heavy precisely while its evil travels fast and far.

context_deltas.mechanism: Across the surah, binding moves through three agencies: a vow binds the self by choice, a captive is bound by others, and created bodily structure is tightly joined. Fulfillment redirects the capacity for binding from domination toward reliable care for the bound.

activation_trace.role: Voluntary self-binding supplies chosen constraint.
Binding and confinement supply the involuntarily constrained person toward whom care is directed.
Tightly coherent bodily formation supplies binding as created structural integrity rather than imprisonment.
Tightening a knot or bond supplies the action that makes bodily cohesion firm.

structural_cues: The same ء س ر cue occurs for the captive in 76:8 and bodily cohesion in 76:28.
The focus vow stands between these uses as a third, voluntary mode of constraint.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies three branch-backed binding forms; I infer an ethical transformation from capacity for constraint to self-constraint in service of the constrained. The alternative is that the shared root and vow image do not form a deliberate agency contrast.

changed_reading.before: Self-binding, captivity, and bodily cohesion are unrelated senses.
changed_reading.after: Vow fulfillment becomes an ethical conversion of binding: the agent binds the self reliably so that external binding does not cancel care for another.

context_deltas.mechanism: The warning branch of نذر gains a whole-surah pathway: reminder becomes operative when willing takes hold of a route. To 'complete' the warning is therefore to convert recollection into a chosen trajectory, not merely to experience alarm.

activation_trace.role: Warning that awakens caution supplies the alternative focus sense being traced.
Full completion supplies the movement from received warning to fully enacted response.
A reminder that causes recollection supplies renewed cognitive availability of the warning.
Willing directed toward a thing supplies volitional uptake rather than automatic reaction.
Taking or acquiring supplies commitment that converts will into an adopted course.
An extended traversable path supplies the durable trajectory produced by the warning.

structural_cues: 76:29 explicitly sequences reminder, willing, taking, and path.
This closing sequence supplies behavioral stages for the warning-fear coupling already latent in 76:7.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reminder, willing, taking, and path; I infer that these stages explain how a warning is fulfilled in conduct. The alternative is that النذر remains exclusively vow here and the reminder sequence only parallels it thematically.

changed_reading.before: The warning reading means only that the subjects are frightened by notice of danger.
changed_reading.after: The warning is completed when recollection becomes willing adoption of a path; fear is one transition in that enacted sequence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This uses the branch-distant image of spreading something in the sun to dry, so it should be rendered only as a spatial-material echo, not as the lexical meaning of شَرّ. It remains anchored in the focus root and becomes live because the reward scene explicitly removes sun exposure and brings protective shade near.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: شَرُّهُ with the ش ر ر sun-spreading branch, reinforced by مُسْتَطِيرًا

activation_trace.role: Spreading material in the sun to dry supplies an exposure-based image for distributed harm.
Flying-loose spread supplies the extension of exposed material across space.
The sun supplies the exposure medium explicitly absent from the protected scene.
Nearness supplies immediate availability of protection rather than remote shelter.
Covering shade supplies containment that reverses exposure.

changed_reading.before: The day's evil spreads in an unspecified way.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it creates an ecology of exposure, while the later scene answers with absent sun and near covering shade.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The wound-compensation branch of نذر is legally specific and form-distant from the ordinary vow construction, so downstream prose must label this reparative frame as exploratory. It remains validly anchored because وفاء supplies full discharge, the focus noun supplies obligatory compensation, and context joins a bound recipient to recompense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يُوفُونَ بِٱلنَّذْرِ through full discharge and obligatory wound-compensation branches

activation_trace.role: Giving a due in full supplies reparative completion.
Obligatory compensation for injury supplies the unusual legal-reparative obligation.
The bound captive supplies a recipient marked by imposed injury or deprivation.
Debt collection and full settlement supply a context-side image of a due being answered.

changed_reading.before: They accurately perform what they promised.
changed_reading.after: At the legal edge of the inventory, fulfillment becomes making a due whole, with provision to the bound carrying reparative force rather than optional generosity.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The diminishment branch of خوف is not the ordinary sense of يَخَافُونَ and should never replace fear in translation. It remains worth carrying as a functional echo: context shows protection from harm and resistance to love of the immediate, allowing fear to be modeled as subtracting present attachment so future danger is not discounted.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يَخَافُونَ through the خوف branch of diminution by taking away

activation_trace.role: Diminishing by taking away supplies a functional image of fear reducing competing attachment.
Repelling harm by protection supplies the preventive endpoint of that subtraction.
Love lodged in the heart supplies what can over-weight the immediate.
Haste and priority supply the immediate bias that anticipatory fear functionally reduces.

changed_reading.before: Fear adds distress to the subject.
changed_reading.after: Functionally and exploratorily, fear also subtracts the grip of the immediate, preserving room for protective future-oriented action.

strongest_changes: Vow fulfillment shifted from private exactness to costly provision for people constrained by poverty, lost guardianship, or captivity.
The spreading evil became one distribution regime set against the deliberately opened and socially circulated flow of drink and care.
Repeated fear-day-evil language followed by protection recast fear as accurate anticipatory orientation rather than passive distress.
The immediate-versus-heavy-day contrast made the focus a model of temporal weighting, with heavy consequence paired paradoxically with fast airborne spread.
Denied human return followed by granted recompense revised the settlement shadow into non-transactional fulfillment.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet exposed recurring mechanisms rather than a single gloss: binding changed agency, distribution changed moral valence, return changed source, and the focus day's spreading evil acquired both material motion and temporal weight.
remaining_uncertainties: The warning sense of النذر is branch-backed but syntactically less immediate than the vow sense and should remain secondary.
The causal arrow from present fear and fulfillment to later protection is plausible from sequence but not grammatically asserted in 76:7 itself.
The exchange activation from the non-dominant ش ر ي mapping is diagnostic and productive but should not be promoted into a direct lexical gloss of شَرّ.
The sun, compensation, and subtractive-fear outliers depend on distant branch images and require explicit exploratory qualification.
